data.desc: Informa TechTarget is a leading global B2B intelligence, media, and marketing services company, purpose-built to be an indispensable partner to the enterprise tech and vertical industry sectors. Our award-winning industry journalism delivers business audiences the information and insights they need to make important decisions. B2B GTM teams trust Informa TechTarget's best-in-class market insights, digital media brands, unified brand-and-demand solutions, content strategy and creation, and exclusive buyer intelligence to identify growth opportunities, build brand trust, engage with in-market buyers, and impact revenue. With 58 million+ permissioned members, Informa TechTarget's robust B2B audience engagement network powers our data-driven, AI-enabled, integrated marketing capabilities, addressing our clients' needs across the GTM lifecycle.
